To say I was excited is an understatement--I've been waiting 25 years to see this movie in theaters again. ​ Just prior to the climax, the woman in front of me pulls out her phone and starts texting. I had a gut reaction (I HATE people who use their phones in movies) and grabbed a handful of popcorn and chucked it at her. My argument is that not using your phone is a written rule of movie theaters. If you break that rule, you're going to have to deal with the consequences. Am I the asshole?
